candidate.subject: double-boiling leaching protocol
candidate.source_evidence_span: The double-boiling leaching protocol reliably lowered potassium by 53–65% and phosphorus by 38– 49% across four starchy vegetables, and the use of egg white as a low-phosphorus binder maintained adequate protein content without re-introducing the minerals removed during leaching.
candidate.relation_trigger: reliably lowered potassium by 53–65% and phosphorus by 38– 49
